lines: Warm water seeps up through the sand. It tastes of copper and old promises.

sign: Under the sun palace. The sundial has stopped. Nobody dares tell the sun.
hint: Palace notice: The great dial door opens while both sun-weights rest on both marks. Do not sit on the marks. This means you, Steward.
corwen: Corwen: Emrys has served four rulers. He buried two and advised the other two. Hard to say which was worse.
corwen_intro: Corwen: The palace is closed to visitors. Also to residents. Duel?
corwen_defeat: Corwen: Go on. Emrys likes people who win. He outlives them anyway.
ettie: Ettie: The dial says it's noon. It's said that for nine days. I've stopped eating lunch on principle.
ettie_intro: Ettie: Let's settle this before the sun moves. So, never.
abel: Abel: I sat on one of the marks once. For a week. The door stayed open and so did my position, until it didn't.
abel_intro: Abel: The palace thanks you for your visit. Now leave or lose.
abel_defeat: Abel: The palace regrets any inconvenience. Mostly its own.

lines: Emrys: The sun stopped. I've waited eighty years for it to need me. Now it does, and I'm too tired to stand up.
Emrys: The sun moves again. So does the Veil, I expect. Let them. The sun outlived every clan in this desert.
Emrys: Take Radiant Lance. Twelve Rifts, twelve seals. The far end of the Wide Rift will open for you now.
Emrys: I've started a sundial for the Undrawn. Nobody knows what time it is there. Ideal working conditions.

emrys_intro: Emrys: So Kaia is unmasked. Yes, I signed as her witness. Someone had to read the small print. Nobody else ever does.
Emrys: Everyone in Solenne works for someone. I work for the sun. It doesn't pay either. Shall we?
emrys_defeat: Emrys: ...There. The dial moved. One minute past noon. I'd forgotten how good that feels.
Emrys: I kept the Veil's contract, you know. The clause about heroes ends their claim. Now it has a hero. Let's mend this.

lines: With the Sun Rift sealed, a soft light walks out of the glare.
A deer with a halo of horn steps closer. A lantern glows inside its chest.
It is Lumivane. Its light wants to know if you are lost.
Old songs say a legend only listens to someone who has tested it hard.
